questions.title: Circle — chords, diameter, and central angle
questions.text:
In the circle below, $O$ is the center. Chord $AC$ and chord $BD$ intersect inside the circle. $AB$ is a diameter of length $d$. The central angle $\angle AOC = 72°$.

(a) Name the arc intercepted by the central angle $\angle AOC$.

(b) What is the measure of arc $AC$?

(c) If two chords intersect inside a circle, state the relationship between the angles formed and the intercepted arcs. Use chords $AC$ and $BD$ to illustrate your answer.
